name: provider-error
description: Spicrawl rejects the request with an unrecognised API key: 401 RFC 7807 problem+json (type, title, status, code, detail). Vendor non-2xx is DATA: the engine classifies it as a provider error and forces zero usage. Recorded 2026-11-25 with a bogus key; serves all three endpoints via the {{request.url}} binding.

body.title: API key not recognised
body.detail: That API key is not recognised.
